title: Siman 334
section: The Virtue of Those Who Drew Close to Him

segments.he: רַבֵּנוּזִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה הִתְפָּאֵר שֶׁלּא הִתְחִיל לַעֲשׂוֹת שׁוּם דָּבָר בָּעוֹלָם קדֶם שֶׁיָּדַע הַסּוֹד שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ. וַאֲפִלּוּ מַה שֶּׁנּוֹהֲגִין לְהַעֲלוֹת עֲשַׁן הַטִּיטוּן עַל-יְדֵי לִילְקֶע וְצִבֶּעךְ (שֶׁקּוֹרִין לוּלְקֶא רֵייכֶערְן) [עִשּׁוּן טַבַּק] לֹא הִתְחִיל בָּזֶה עַד
segments.en: (44.) I heard that once Rabbainu z"l told of the virtue of those who draw close to him o.b.m. — that even when someone's mind becomes somewhat confused and distorted, G-d save us — even so, they are firm in complete faith in him o.b.m. And he told of one of his people who was a great tzaddik — and Rabbainu o.b.m. said about him that this man had the repentance of the Book of the Kaneh. And it is explained in the books [Teshuvas HaKaneh, 12b] that whoever does this repentance is assured he will not sin again. "And on his behalf — meaning on behalf of this man — I am a guarantor that he certainly will not sin." And it came to pass that this man's mind became somewhat confused . And he will bring him to merit.
